conflicts.spec1: Complete Async Ripple Changes for SurrealDB Official Library
conflicts.description: surrealdb-primary-redis-cache wants to add Redis cache updates to update_metrics_after_execution(). However, that function was just converted to async def with merge() by this spec. The Redis cache code must also be async.
conflicts.impact: If surrealdb-primary-redis-cache enforcement proceeds without accounting for async changes, Redis cache operations will fail because they expect sync db operations.

steps: 1. This spec (Complete Async Ripple Changes) has been fully enforced - 100% PASS
2. Update surrealdb-primary-redis-cache enforcement plan to use async patterns
3. Add 'await' to all Redis cache operations in updated functions

technicalDetails.thisSpecChanges:
async def update_metrics_after_execution(...):
    db = await get_surreal_client()
    result = await db.merge(record_id, update_data)  # Changed from update()
technicalDetails.dependentSpecNeeds:
async def update_metrics_after_execution(...):
    db = await get_surreal_client()
    result = await db.merge(record_id, update_data)
    # MUST ADD await here:
    await update_redis_cache(template_id, result)

conflicts.spec1: Complete Async Ripple Changes for SurrealDB Official Library
conflicts.description: surrealdb-primary-redis-cache validation FAILED (5/6 tests passed) because execution recording write order is incorrect. This spec fixes the async patterns that enable proper write ordering.

validationFailure.issue: SurrealDB write happens before Redis invalidation, but operations may not execute in expected order
validationFailure.rootCause: Async operations not properly awaited, causing race conditions

resolution.details: This spec (Complete Async Ripple Changes) fixed all async/await issues. Now surrealdb-primary-redis-cache can properly implement write ordering because all db operations are correctly awaited.
resolution.nextStep: Re-enforce surrealdb-primary-redis-cache Phase 2 with proper async patterns
